d: Sam and Cat take care of a goat and try to win over their landlord's son, who wants them evicted. Dice starts managing Goomer, a dumb MMA fighter.
Sam and Cat babysit two polite British girls; Sam tries to fulfill a community service requirement at Elderly Acres.

When a babysitting client says, "You're my favorite babysitter ever", Sam and Cat debate which one of them he meant. They compete for their new clients' affection to see who really is the best babysitter.

When a babysitting client says, 'You're my favorite babysitter ever', Sam and Cat debate which one of them he meant. They compete for their new clients' affection to see who really is the best babysitter.
Sam and Cat confront a competing baby-sitting service when they post bad reviews about Sam and Cat's baby-sitting service.
Cat convinces Sam to participate in a texting competition; Dice tries to avoid an old friend.
Gwen and Ruby return and, while pretending to be friendly, try to drive a wedge between Sam and Cat.
Sam, Dice and Goomer go to a mixed-martial arts fight, leaving Cat at home to study; Sam's motorcycle goes missing; Cat loses her memory.
Dice enlists the help of Sam and Cat to convince Goomer's mother that Goomer is a high school teacher.
Sam and Cat make a commercial for their business that features Dice's dog; a family claims that Dice's dog belongs to them.
Sam opens a safe in her bedroom and discovers a tunnel leading to a secret room; Cat films herself for 24 hours.
Sam and Cat are hired to baby-sit a doll on Halloween; Cat thinks she may have turned Dice into a monkey.
When Sam and Cat watch an accident-prone boy, they are determined to show him a good time while keeping him out of harm's way.
Cat plays a trick on Sam using a pair of twins that they are a babysitting; Sam retaliates with a prank on Cat.
Sam and Cat are ordered to rename their babysitting business because it is too similar to a television show from the 1970s.
Sam and Cat are tasked with getting a child to give up her ratty, old stuffed animal.
Sam gets a job as the assistant to rapper, Peezy B; Cat finds babysitting much more challenging without Sam around to help.
Sam eats all of the meatballs that Cat has prepared for a special Moon Dinner; Cat becomes obsessed with finding the match to a shoe.
Cat invents a holiday so she can buy gifts for everyone; Cat snoops to find out what other people's gifts are.
Sam and Cat try to get the word \lumpatious\ into the dictionary after making a bet that it is a real word.
Sam notices that Cat is spending a lot of money; Cat shows Sam a “Magic ATM” that gives away free money.
Cat feels left out by Jade and Sam, so she befriends an old friend of Sam's; this competition for affection ends up getting out of hand.
Sam tries to get revenge on Cat by befriending Robbie; Dice wins a tank of man-eating tuna fish in a poker game.
Sam and Cat begin to notice that their friends are obsessed with a new phone game; the audience is distracted at Cat's one woman show.
Sam and Cat start making their own version of their favorite soda after it is banned.
Jennette McCurdy, Ariana Grande, Cameron Ocasio, Maree Cheatham and Zoran Korach are on a lunch break from filming “Sam & Cat”; the cast is interrupted by fans of the show.
Sam and Cat promise to buy a doll for a girl if she raises her grades; Sam and Cat are financially strained; Goomer loses his lucky shirt.
The gang must rescue Cat when she is trapped inside of one of Dice's magic tricks.
Sam and Cat encounter problems when they try a new drone delivery service online.
Sam and Cat are hired to accompany two obnoxious children on a flight to the Bahamas.
Nora targets Dice as a way to get revenge on Sam; Sam and Cat are forced to ask Nevel for help.
While helping Goomer with a bully at his gym, Sam knocks out an MMA champion.
Sam and Cat try to avoid getting in trouble when they accidentally knock out musician Del DeVille.
Cat takes Dice to a hair modeling job in Arizona; Sam is stuck at home with Nona for a weekend roommate.
Former iCarly sidekick Sam Puckett teams up with Hollywood Arts High School student Cat Valentine to take over Cat's grandmother's babysitting service.
Cat is devastated when a cable network cancels a TV show about a family of cross-dressers.
